svg.title: web-02 EVV exception queue (Agency Web App)
svg.desc: Low-fidelity wireframe of the EVV exception queue for Lakemont North: filters, a bulk-resolve bar for three selected Low GPS accuracy exceptions, a table of nine open exceptions with server-computed details, and a time correction panel that adds a Manual clock-out with a required reason code and note for an auto-closed visit. Numbered callouts 1 to 9.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Bulk resolve is limited to Low GPS accuracy and identity checks that failed because the vendor was unavailable.
